detailed_descriptions.en: Equip yourself with some of the finest hardware Sweden has to offer. These classics are as powerful as they are reliable, trusted by gangsters and military alike. Now, they’ve found their way into your hands. Russell JB-9 A high-capacity, high-fire-rate automatic secondary that shines with unmistakable 80s charm. Skogskrigare AG-9 A dependable mid-range rifle, striking a balance between power and control in any firefight. Studsgranat S18 A grenade that hits the ground, then springs upward to detonate at face level. Karl Alfred M606 A heavy-duty bazooka capable of firing explosive, HEAT, or smoke rounds to suit your needs.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Equip yourself with some of the finest hardware Sweden has to offer. These classics are as powerful as they are reliable, trusted by gangsters and military alike. Now, they’ve found their way into your hands.

Russell JB-9

A high-capacity, high-fire-rate automatic secondary that shines with unmistakable 80s charm.

Skogskrigare AG-9

A dependable mid-range rifle, striking a balance between power and control in any firefight.

Studsgranat S18

A grenade that hits the ground, then springs upward to detonate at face level.

Karl Alfred M606

A heavy-duty bazooka capable of firing explosive, HEAT, or smoke rounds to suit your needs.
